visual.general_description: Two side-by-side, greenish-tinted volume-rendered 3D views of a skull and upper cervical spine with a plate-like metallic structure curving below the maxilla.
visual.detailed_description: The image is a photograph or capture of a monitor or film with a blue-green cast, divided by a vertical line into a left image and a right image; the two images are not lettered. Both show a three-dimensional bone-surface rendering of the skull, upper teeth, orbit and cervical vertebrae from an oblique side direction, the left image with the face directed to the right and the right image with the face directed to the left. In each image a long chain-like plate with round screw holes runs from the region behind the lower face down and around beneath the upper teeth, forming a loop under the maxilla; no bony mandibular body is visible in the span the plate occupies. Short orientation letters "PR" and "AR" appear at the left margin of the left and right images, and small overlay text fragments, a time-like or counter-like fragment and a partly legible strip of text appear in the corners and bottom margins; these are small and not reliably legible. No scale bar, arrow, colour legend or measurement is visible.

visual.general_description: Intraoperative close-up of an open lower-face and neck surgical field with the tongue protruding and surgical instruments below.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph of a draped person lying with the head tilted back. Blue surgical drapes cover the surroundings and a gloved hand is at the upper left. The visible face is the lower half only: nostrils, upper lip with a black suture crossing the midline, and a cheek with stubble. The mouth is open and the tongue lies to the right of centre. Below and to the right, the lower face is opened into a wide raw wound with red muscle, pale fibrous and bony-looking surfaces and bleeding edges; at the lower left, ragged dark red tissue is held near the gloved hand with several thin white tubular strands and metal clamps and forceps lying across the bottom edge. A metal stand is visible at the upper right. No labels, arrows, scale or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Photograph of a harvested fibular osteocutaneous flap lying on a blue drape.
visual.detailed_description: Vertical color photograph of an elongated tissue specimen on a blue surgical drape. The upper part shows a skin paddle edge with fatty yellow tissue and a dark crusted spot at the top. In the middle, two cream-coloured bone segments are visible, one crossing toward the upper right and one lower, each with cut ends, surrounded by red muscle and connective tissue; dark clotted tissue protrudes at the right edge. Pale glistening muscle and fascia lie to the left, and the lower third is a large glossy yellow-red fatty surface. No labels, arrows, scale, vessels clearly identifiable as artery or vein, or text are visible.
